method: Same MIDI 52/55/59/62/66/69/74, velocity 100; stereo power, measured first 15 harmonics. Lower spectral centroid alone does not determine perceived realism.

capture.conversion: Each note directly from original SF2 PCM to 48000 Hz; no intermediate-rate source. Stereo and SF2 envelopes retained. No per-note normalization.

measurement.window: 80-ms Hann; six sustain ages 180–580 ms; 15 partials; stereo power
measurement.frequencySearch: 81 frequencies over nominal +/-2%; H1 power + 0.25 H2 power
measurement.envelope: 10-ms stereo RMS every 5 ms; attack normalized to pre-note-off maximum, release to mean RMS in final 50 ms before note-off
measurement.reference: FluidR3 sample-bank synthesis, not an acoustic violin measurement
